phase: Secondary prospective protocol after input support audit, before examining prediction errors.
status: Main old-to-new test and all its results are retained; no replacement of primary endpoint.
reason: The new chip has3173 QC single-guide sources and49243 receivers. Fit on its high-support training regions to separate limited old-chip training support from estimator behavior.
split: Leave each of the three geometry components represented among receivers out once; train on the other components. Components are not asserted to be independent animals.
parameters: Same frozen method,three updates,unchanged four source targets and two readout panels. No test-outcome tuning.
primary: Equal-block observed count error, separately for all three component holdouts; source-on versus source-zero and independently fitted background-only.
secondary: Centered block error reported separately. All fold directions retained.
replication_limit: New-data within-chip spatial validation, not independently repeated animals.
